CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_record_waste(p_business_id uuid, p_inventory_item_id uuid, p_location_id uuid, p_qty numeric, p_reason text, p_notes text)
 RETURNS waste_transactions
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_stock inventory_stock;
  v_tx inventory_transactions;
  v_waste waste_transactions;
BEGIN

 IF p_qty IS NOT NULL AND p_qty::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'p_qty must be finite'; END IF;
  IF p_business_id IS DISTINCT FROM current_business_id() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'business_id mismatch';
  END IF;

  IF NOT coalesce(user_can('manageInventory'), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission denied: manageInventory required';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM inventory_items
    WHERE id = p_inventory_item_id
      AND business_id = p_business_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'inventory item not found';
  END IF;

  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM locations
    WHERE id = p_location_id
      AND business_id = p_business_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'location not found';
  END IF;

  IF p_qty IS NULL OR p_qty <= 0 OR p_qty::text IN ('NaN', 'Infinity', '-Infinity') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'waste quantity must be greater than zero';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_stock
  FROM inventory_stock
  WHERE inventory_item_id = p_inventory_item_id
    AND location_id = p_location_id FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_stock.qty < p_qty THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'only % in stock — cannot waste more than that',
      v_stock.qty;
  END IF;

  v_tx := fn_record_inventory_movement(
    p_business_id,
    p_inventory_item_id,
    p_location_id,
    'WASTE',
    -p_qty,
    v_stock.avg_cost_per_unit,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    'Reason: ' || p_reason,
    FALSE
  );

  INSERT INTO waste_transactions (
    business_id,
    inventory_item_id,
    location_id,
    qty,
    unit,
    reason,
    cost,
    notes,
    inventory_transaction_id,
    created_by
  )
  SELECT
    p_business_id,
    p_inventory_item_id,
    p_location_id,
    p_qty,
    i.unit,
    p_reason,
    round(p_qty * v_stock.avg_cost_per_unit, 2),
    p_notes,
    v_tx.id,
    auth.uid()
  FROM inventory_items i
  WHERE i.id = p_inventory_item_id
  RETURNING * INTO v_waste;

  RETURN v_waste;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_read_inventory_stock_secure()
 RETURNS SETOF inventory_stock
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT s.id,s.inventory_item_id,s.location_id,s.qty,
 CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN s.avg_cost_per_unit ELSE NULL END AS avg_cost_per_unit,
 CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN s.last_purchase_cost ELSE NULL END AS last_purchase_cost,
 CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN s.last_purchase_date ELSE NULL END AS last_purchase_date,
 s.created_at,s.updated_at
 FROM public.inventory_stock s JOIN public.inventory_items i ON i.id=s.inventory_item_id
 WHERE i.business_id=public.current_business_id()
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_read_inventory_transactions_secure()
 RETURNS SETOF inventory_transactions
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT t.id,t.business_id,t.inventory_item_id,t.location_id,t.type,t.qty_change,t.unit,
CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN t.unit_cost ELSE NULL END,
CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN t.total_cost ELSE NULL END,
t.sale_id,t.purchase_order_id,t.related_transaction_id,
CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN t.prev_avg_cost ELSE NULL END,
CASE WHEN public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN t.new_avg_cost ELSE NULL END,
t.note,t.created_by,t.created_at
FROM public.inventory_transactions t WHERE t.business_id=public.current_business_id() $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_read_purchase_order_items_secure()
 RETURNS SETOF purchase_order_items
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ SELECT pi.id,pi.purchase_order_id,pi.inventory_item_id,pi.qty_ordered,pi.unit,
CASE WHEN public.user_can('managePurchases') OR public.user_can('manageRecipesAndCosts') THEN pi.unit_cost ELSE NULL END,
pi.received_qty FROM public.purchase_order_items pi JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=pi.purchase_order_id WHERE po.business_id=public.current_business_id() $function$
